# orion

<!-- Generated by tools/cgen.c from orion/script/orion.cgen. Do not edit. -->

```lua
local orion = require("orion")
```

Refusals, translation and the catalogue's number and date formats.

## `orion.fail(message)`

Refuses the action: the page stays as it was and the message shows to the user.

| Argument | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `message` | string | What the user should know, in a whole sentence |

Returns nothing; the action stops here.

## `orion.assert(value [, message])`

Passes its arguments on, or refuses the action when the first is false or nil.

orion.assert(row:update{...}) passes on the message a model returned with nil, as Routes.assert does in lua-objc.

| Argument | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | any | The value to check |
| `message` | string, optional | The refusal; a generic sentence when absent |

Returns every argument, when the value holds.

## `orion.tr(text)`

Translates a whole sentence through the string catalogs.

| Argument | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | The English text |

Returns the translation, or the text itself.

## `orion.formatNumber(value [, decimals])`

A number in the catalogue's format.

| Argument | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | number | The number |
| `decimals` | integer, optional | Digits after the separator Default 2. |

Returns the formatted number.

## `orion.formatDate(iso)`

An ISO date ("2026-03-31") in the catalogue's format.

| Argument | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `iso` | string | The date |

Returns the formatted date.

## `orion.parseNumber(text)`

A number typed in the catalogue's format.

| Argument | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | The text |

Returns the number, 0 when the text is not one.

## `orion.parseDate(text)`

A date typed in the catalogue's format, as an ISO date.

| Argument | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | The text |

Returns the ISO date, or nil when the text is not a date.

## `orion.today()`

Today's date.

Returns today as an ISO date.
